## Description
Briefly describe the change and its motivation or context.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement or refactoring
- [ ] Localization / i18n update

## How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] Unit tests added / updated and passing (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passing (`pnpm run compile`)
- [ ] Manual verification in browser (Chrome / Edge)

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Add before/after screenshots for visual UI changes.

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass.
- [ ] No external network telemetry or analytics calls have been introduced.
